title: In Amber Clad
tagline: Command fleets across an infinite hex grid from an amber terminal.
description: A space strategy game played through an amber CRT console. Single-player build: the whole engine runs in your browser tab against built-in bots, and your save lives in the browser.

title: GemTD
tagline: Place gems, build a maze, survive the waves.
description: A remake of the classic Warcraft 3 gem tower-defense map. Place gems to build a maze, combine and upgrade them, and survive the waves. Deterministic simulation, rendered with WebGPU.

title: Gravity Duel
tagline: A two-player gravity duel, faithful to the original rules.
description: An exact-mechanics remake of Bombardiers Guild: fly, fire and fight under gravity. Rust compiled to WebAssembly.

title: Particle Life
tagline: Emergent behavior from simple attraction and repulsion rules.
description: A recreation of Nikita Lisitsa's Particle Life 2D simulation, rebuilt in Zig + WebAssembly with GPU-accelerated rendering. Original demo: https://lisyarus.github.io/webgpu/particle-life.html
